# Macro calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/macro-calculator/

Convert your calorie budget and chosen macro split into grams. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Split a 2,000 kcal budget into 50% carbohydrate, 20% protein and 30% fat.

## Limits and checks

You choose the calorie amount and split. The tool converts units; it does not prescribe a diet or claim an ideal split.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [USDA FNIC — macronutrient energy factors](https://www.nal.usda.gov/programs/fnic)
